ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   C. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   D. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   B. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   C. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   B. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Obligations of Parents to Children and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Obligation of children to parents 02 6.3 Children’s obligation to other family m and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Obligations of Children to Parents and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Children’s obligation to other family members 03 7 Islamic Heritage and Civilisa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
